title: Ask HN: Is the web for machines (/llm.txt) the one we wished we had as humans?
summary: A HN user shares frustration with modern marketing-heavy websites and proposes that the AI/LLM revolution might inadvertently improve web experience for humans. They manually visit `/llm.txt` endpoints to get cleaner, direct content and wonder if this trend could benefit everyone.
problem_solved: Eliminates marketing bloat and parsing friction when accessing web content, both for LLMs and humans.
why_valuable: It proposes a cleaner, distraction-free web format that serves both machine consumers (LLMs) and humans seeking direct information.
